name: OmaApple
author: OmaApple contributors
description: Apple Music in Quickshell — native Omarchy UI, official Apple APIs, hidden MusicKit JS playback.

barWidget.description: Native Apple Music UI for Omarchy, with official MusicKit JS playback.

schema.label: Sleep empty local player
schema.description: Minutes after every player surface closes when nothing is playing. Paused media stays available to resume. Use 0 to keep the helper running.

schema.label: Open mini-player from bar
schema.description: When off, clicking the bar icon opens the full player directly.

schema.label: Keyboard shortcut opens
schema.description: Choose whether Super+Shift+M launches Omarchy's Music app, the full player, or the mini-player. The plugin never writes Hyprland config; Settings shows the bind snippet.

schema.label: Bar text scroll speed
schema.description: Multiplier from 0.25 to 3.00. The default speed is 1.

schema.label: Maximum bar text width
schema.description: Width from 160 to 560 px. Use 0 for unlimited.

schema.label: Playback origin
schema.description: v1 default is stock Chromium on Apple origin. Loopback is an experiment. CastLabs is an optional user-installed escape hatch (Settings can switch; we do not vendor CastLabs Electron).
